title: Ichthyology: Phishing as a Science
summary: Karla Burnett presents real phishing campaigns run against a Bay Area tech company, including conversion rates and how existing protections were bypassed. She argues for evidence-based techniques to prevent credential phishing, not just mitigate it.
why: HN people cite it to show even technical users fall for phishing and that hardware security keys are the real fix.

quote.text: shows just how easy it is to phish even users who think they are too good to be fooled.
